dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Prominent closed 'O' and semi-closed 'C' shapes exhibit irregular, serrated outer perimeters. There is a sharp gradient transition from dark-toned exterior pixels to high-intensity white/cream interior perimeters, particularly visible in the large elliptical structure on the upper dorsal flank.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate density of isolated, solid high-intensity pixel clusters lacking internal gradients. These blobs are primarily situated in the interstices between larger annular structures along the dorsal ridge.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three most prominent annular structures form an obtuse scalene triangle. The spatial arrangement of the central-most cluster of rings forms a triangular polygon with internal angles of approximately 140, 25, and 15 degrees.
